verdicts.recommendation: C2.1 Migration 045 kb_* tables, service-role RLS, hash identity key, harden 012
verdicts.reason: 045 is free (039 is reserved for the M13-29 RLS work) and the 044 REVOKE/GRANT pattern fits. Hardening 012 is safe: every reader uses the admin client. The key recipe is the weak part. dedup_brand_name is a display builder that keeps the name's casing, not a normaliser. spine_key already folds brand aliases and category padding. A third key would compete with it, and stripping the axes merges supplement doses when the token is empty.
evidence: C:/Users/SynAckITPC/Documents/AI/sc-s80-b2/app/services/spec_spine_service.py:190-240 (existing spine_key with brand alias groups and padding subtraction)
verdicts.fix: Derive kb_product_id from spine_key's brand axis plus identity tokens minus padding, without ml, and key the variant on concentration plus ml. Put the 012 REVOKE in its own migration (not 039) with a postcheck, and add a test_migration_045 pin modelled on test_migration_044.

verdicts.recommendation: C2.2 fire_and_forget kb_ingest after build_comparison_response; KB read point; TTLs
verdicts.reason: Right after build_comparison_response is the wrong place. L3 moderation runs after it and can turn the result into CONTENT_UNAVAILABLE, so refused compares would be ingested. Timeout partials skip the builder entirely. The fetch_page_price result drops image/sku/gtin. run_db runs inline while ENABLE_SYNC_DB_OFFLOAD is OFF, which blocks the single-worker loop. The unified-search gate reads L1 only, and that search also feeds the free image tier.
evidence: C:/Users/SynAckITPC/Documents/AI/sc-s80-b2/app/services/structured_comparison_service.py:4602,4677-4692,4706 (build, then moderation refusal, then return); stream :5447,5531-5565
verdicts.fix: Ingest from product_data at the success return after moderation (:4706 and before the complete yield at :5564), always through asyncio.to_thread. Plumb the image and GTIN through the price result under the flag. Gate the KB/L2 short-circuit of the unified search behind its own flag, with an explicit image fallback, and re-pin test_stage_timings and test_smart_fallback.

verdicts.recommendation: C2.3 Persistent per-host merchant registry seeded from bh_gcc_sources, per-call TTL read
verdicts.reason: Counts verified: 368 rows, 275 live, 199 blank mechanism. A per-call registry is feasible, because consumers import SOURCE_REGISTRY lazily, but it is built at import (:532) and the loader drops country and genuine_method. Health cannot come from _record_provider_attempt: only the Firecrawl and Scrape.do wrappers call it, never curl or the adapters, so ~275 rows would have no signal. Seeding from the literals copies the fragrantica.com row.
verdicts.fix: Add an attempt hook to the curl wave and every adapter before using it as the health source. Exclude the Fragrantica and Parfumo rows at seed time. Keep flag-OFF SOURCE_REGISTRY identical, pinned by test_bh_gcc_registry_loader and test_registry_liveness_gate.

verdicts.recommendation: C2.4 Owned QarenBot crawler, robots fail-closed on live path, politeness, OSS picks
verdicts.reason: The named UA and contact page already exist for the off-clock robots read. Enforcing robots on the LIVE path clashes with the code: fetch_page_price and 13 adapter modules fetch with Chrome impersonation (32 sites). Judging robots as QarenBot while fetching as Chrome is incoherent, and switching the UA puts the measured 84% curl capture at risk. An inline robots GET also eats into the 15 s race. robots_eval has no Crawl-delay support, and Protego/extruct/price-parser are not in requirements.
verdicts.fix: The live path should read a persisted robots verdict from the registry (fetched off-clock with the named UA) and never fetch robots inline. Get an owner ruling on the live adapter UA before enforcing. Park Scrape.do super mode on challenged hosts, all behind a default-OFF flag.

verdicts.recommendation: C2.5 Port seed_spec_spine to Haiku, seed corpora, persist identity per compare, open-data policy
verdicts.reason: The seeder calls OpenAI chat.completions, and requirements.txt pins only openai==3.3.1 with no anthropic SDK, so the port needs a new dependency and client. Its default corpora (_proof/html) are not in this checkout. spine_key includes ml, so notes are stored once per bottle size. 035 is unapplied. The per-compare GTIN/image persistence depends on the dropped fields (13951) and on wide_candidate_enabled. The open-data and licence rules hold.
evidence: C:/Users/SynAckITPC/Documents/AI/sc-s80-b2/app/services/price_service.py:10950-10970 (cand image/sku only under the wide-candidate path)
verdicts.fix: Add the Anthropic SDK through a provider adapter, key specs per juice (no ml), write seed output to the service-role table rather than a repo JSON file, and plumb GTIN and image through the price result under the KB flag.

verdicts.recommendation: C2.6 Robotoff-style insights/votes, RapidFuzz+Splink+Haiku merge, UCP MCP probe, Open Prices fields
verdicts.reason: Auto-applying device-keyed votes repeats M13-29: anonymous feedback is written with the service role from client-supplied ids, so anyone can forge votes and poison facts above the threshold. The UCP probe covered only 6 advertising hosts, no MCP handshake was ever done, and /collections/all is currency-blind. The GTIN field list lacks gtin14, and no check-digit code exists. Splink is heavy, so it must stay off-clock.
verdicts.fix: Never auto-apply from votes. Weight votes by attested device and quota, and auto-apply only machine predictions backed by cited merchant evidence. Run the UCP MCP probe off-clock on the 6 known hosts first. Add gtin14 and a check-digit validator.

verdicts.recommendation: C2.7 Image cascade URL-only, fix cand[image] drop under B7, Haiku validation, https rule
verdicts.reason: The drop location is right: the result at 13951-13961 omits cand[image], which is set at 10964. But ENABLE_IMAGE_PIPELINE_V2 (B7) does not exist anywhere in app/, so it has to be created. The current piggyback override also accepts http://. An inline Haiku yes/no per non-JSON-LD candidate adds a paid call inside the 5 s image race on every compare, which works against faster compares.
evidence: grep ENABLE_IMAGE_PIPELINE_V2 app/ = 0 hits; CLAUDE.md:313 names it as unit B7
verdicts.fix: Create the B7 flag and carry cand image onto the price result under it. Tighten the override to https, public host and raster type. Run Haiku validation and pHash off-clock at KB ingest, not inline in the image race.

new_risks: fragrantica.com is still a literal registry row (source_router.py:347) and URL mode has no deny list, so any registry seed, KB discovery or ingest-from-URL path would bring in a banned source unless it is filtered explicitly.

Offers served from the KB/L2 would ship without captured_at, because get_cached_price drops fetched_at (product_data_service.py:290-297). Stale prices could appear as current, which breaks the no-fabricated-numbers rule unless the read path and the wire carry capture time.

Currency truth: the registry's country field means 'serves BH', and 17 BH rows price in another currency. The proposed kb_offers schema has no observed-currency or evidence-rung column, so the KB could keep a mislabelled currency permanently instead of letting it expire on a 7 d TTL.

Ingest inherits filter bias: the counterfeit substring filter drops genuine 'Replica' (Maison Margiela) and 'infused' listings before they reach any KB write point, so the owned KB would never learn them.

Single-worker uvicorn with ENABLE_SYNC_DB_OFFLOAD default OFF: per-compare KB writes plus per-call registry reads run blocking Supabase calls on the event loop and can turn latency into 15 s race and stream hard-cap timeouts for other users.

Public repo: seed outputs (data/spec_spine.json) and any partner/CTA commercial fields placed in bh_gcc_sources.json would be published. Partner terms and KB seed data must live only in service-role tables.
